title: Sol by Sensa hair restoration serum
text: A lab-to-bottle brand film for a hair restoration serum, made as a sample for Sensa in Miami. Spec ad, not commissioned by or affiliated with Sensa
idea: Science sells trust, so the ad walks through how the product gets made before it ever shows the bottle: glassware and vapour, hair under the magnifier, colour swatches and a sketch, then the finished pump bottle with its ingredients and dose on the label. Made as a sample for Sensa, the Wynwood bathhouse and med spa that offers hair restoration.
why: The lab story earns trust before the product appears.
Ingredients and dose stay readable, which matters for a clinical product.
Calm grey and white tones look clinical and premium, right for a med spa line.
